_comment: RD-009 release manifest template. Do not commit a filled-out copy of this file to source control if it references a real build artifact path outside the repo — copy it into your durable artifact-retention store instead (see RD_release_rollback_runbook.md). No secrets belong in this file.

edge_functions._comment: Manual entry required — no automated correlation exists between a client build and Edge Function deployed versions. Populate from `supabase functions list --project-ref <ref>` at build/release time.

db_migration_state._comment: Last migration confirmed applied to production per `supabase migration list --linked` — not necessarily the last file in supabase/migrations/ (see BR-002).
